action.objective: Resolve the check by recapturing bxc3, restoring material (two bishops for rook) and keeping the c6-knight.
action.rationale: b2c3 is the only commit_ready move: verified single-candidate at depth 4, exact score -39, safety.complete with no mating reply and no tactical/checking-chain refutation. It captures the checking dark-squared bishop on c3, resolving the check. PV ...bxc6 a1b1 O-O gives White the bishop pair and open lines. Alternatives d1d2 and f4d2 both lose the queen to ...Bxd2 (-834, -295 upper bounds), so b2c3 is clearly best.
